description: Holzinger and Swineford dataset (9 variables) distributed with the lavaan R package.
upstream_source_note: Documented by lavaan as originally retrieved from http://web.missouri.edu/~kolenikovs/stata/hs-cfa.dta (link no longer active) and converted to an R dataset.
original_references: Holzinger, K., & Swineford, F. (1939). A study in factor analysis: The stability of a bifactor solution. Supplementary Educational Monograph, no. 48. Chicago: University of Chicago Press.
Joreskog, K. G. (1969). A general approach to confirmatory maximum likelihood factor analysis. Psychometrika, 34, 183-202.
suggested_benchmark_model:
visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3
textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
speed =~ x7 + x8 + x9

reference_statistics.reference_source_note: Reference fit statistics and selected loadings summarized from the lavaan CFA tutorial / commonly cited Holzinger-Swineford example values.

notes: The current psysem SEM implementation is still a prototype and does not yet target full lavaan-level agreement on every fit statistic.
The first benchmark therefore emphasizes Level A/B contract checks and only a partial Level C alignment for selected loadings and fit indices.

usage_in_repository: SEM benchmark regression tests and reference comparisons.

copyright_and_reuse.public_domain_note: Current upstream documentation does not establish that this dataset is in the public domain.
copyright_and_reuse.repo_distribution_note: This repository stores a CSV copy for benchmark use together with provenance and citation metadata.
